audience: customer service and operations teams reviewing SMSGlobal messages and contacts

useCases.title: Prepare replies to inbound SMS
useCases.text: Review incoming messages, then inspect a selected message’s origin, destination and timestamp to draft a reply in your AI client.

useCases.title: Investigate a message’s delivery state
useCases.text: Search outgoing history and inspect the message parts, destination and returned delivery state for a selected message.

useCases.title: Check contacts and opt-outs
useCases.text: Choose a contact group, read its contacts and check the opted-out numbers before preparing a customer follow-up.

useCases.title: Review available sending identities
useCases.text: Read dedicated numbers, verified origin numbers and sender ID approval states to understand which identities are recorded on the account.
